{{Quote|Welcome to Teptixii, Captain Drusan, ''[&hellip;]'' Captain Voss Parck, currently commanding Task Force ''Admonitor''.|Captain Voss Parck greets Captain Calo Drusan|<ref name="Choices of One">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
'''Teptixii''' was a [[Color/Legends|blue-green]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Choices of One" /> located in the [[Teptixii system/Legends|Teptixii system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Choices of One" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Task Force Admonitor|Task Force ''Admonitor'']] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] [[Engagement at Teptixii|engaged]] [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s eight [[Firekiln]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and twenty-seven escort [[Starship/Legends|ships]] alongside Captain [[Calo Drusan]]'s Imperial Star Destroyer [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] over the planet. Nuso Esva&mdash;posing as [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] member [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Odo aboard the ''Chimaera''&mdash;advised Drusan to divide [[Gender/Legends|his]] ships by coming behind them, which was successful in prompting them to retreat to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Choices of One" />
